text:
josh-docs: opened PR updating the Atlas-6B model card with supported variants, sequence limits, and a short SDK v2 snippet (https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1203). Need a quick look on limits and a link fix.

katie-eng: quick skim  the q4 variant shows max_seq 3072 but bench runs on orion-lite hit 6144 when using the `high-memory` profile. suggest we list: default 3072, profile-enabled up to 6144 (hardware dependent).

miriam-devex: CI flagged a broken anchor from the card to the "profiles" section; the card points to `#runtime-profiles` but site uses `#profiles`.

ci-bot: link-checker: 1 failure  sources/docs/model-catalog/atlas-6b.md: anchor '#runtime-profiles' not found.

josh-docs: thanks, I'll update the anchor and add a short clarifying sentence about profiles and fallbacks. Also will add SDK snippet using `profile='high-memory'`.

katie-eng: use the v2 param name `profile` in the snippet and add a commented example showing `atlas-6b-fp16` for lower latency. keep it tiny.

miriam-devex: add one-sentence fallback note: "If the requested profile is unavailable the router may fallback to a compatible variant or region, which can affect latency."

josh-docs: done  pushed commits, fixed anchor, added snippet and a brief benchmark footnote (batch=1).

ci-bot: pr-check: doc-lint passed, link-checker passed.

miriam-devex: small copy edit pushed.

katie-eng: approved.

josh-docs: merged. I'll monitor any downstream issues. :white_check_mark:
